cues.zh: 有个问题想问有志成为编剧的人：
cues.en: Here's a question for aspiring screenwriters:

cues.zh: 有没有可能通过一些相对小的改动，让《太空旅客》这部电影变得更好？
cues.en: Is it possible to make the movie "Passengers" better with some relatively minor changes?

cues.zh: 说实话，我不觉得这是部烂片。
cues.en: You know, I don't think this is a really bad film.

cues.zh: 听了朋友和网上的评论后，我本以为会是。
cues.en: After hearing reviews from friends and online, I sort of expected it to be.

cues.zh: 但我觉得那种感觉多半是期待落空。 《太空旅客》绝不是一场灾难。
cues.en: But I think that feeling was mostly disappointed expectation. Passengers is by no means a train wreck.

cues.zh: 它只是真的、真的很好猜。剧情是这样的：
cues.en: It's just really, really predictable. The plot goes like this:

cues.zh: 星际飞船“阿瓦隆号”发生故障后，Chris Pratt 在应该苏醒的九十年前就从休眠中醒了过来。
cues.en: After the interstellar spaceship, Avalon, malfunctions, Chris Pratt wakes up from hyper sleep ninety years before he's supposed to.

cues.zh: 比船上其他任何人都早九十年。
cues.en: Ninety years before anyone else on the ship.

cues.zh: 他没法回去继续睡。他联系不上地球。他也碰不到飞船的控制系统。
cues.en: He can't go back to sleep. He can't contact earth. He can't get to the ship's controls.

cues.zh: 他试了所有这些事，全都失败了。
cues.en: He tries to do all of these things and fails.

cues.zh: 一年过去，他越来越悲伤绝望。
cues.en: As a year passes, he grows increasingly sad and hopeless.

cues.zh: 最终他决定唤醒另一位乘客，詹妮弗·劳伦斯，让她也遭受同样的命运，实质上就是死亡。
cues.en: So eventually he decides to wake up another passenger, Jennifer Lawrence, condemning her to the same fate, essentially death.

cues.zh: 好给自己多一个伴儿。他假装这是又一次故障。
cues.en: In order to give himself some more company. He acts like it's another malfunction.

cues.zh: 他没告诉她真相。过了一阵子，两人相爱了。
cues.en: He doesn't tell her. After a while, they fall in love.

cues.zh: 她发现了真相，非常生气，然后飞船开始真正出故障了。
cues.en: She finds out the truth, gets really mad, and then the ship begins to really malfunction.

cues.zh: 于是普拉特牺牲自己去救飞船，但最后是她救了他。
cues.en: So Pratt sacrifices himself to save it, but in the end, she saves him.

cues.zh: 他们再次相爱，在飞船上独自度过余生，幸福地生活在一起。
cues.en: They fall in love again, and spend the rest of their lives alone on the ship, happily ever after.

cues.zh: 哦对了，劳伦斯·菲什伯恩也在里面。
cues.en: Oh and Laurence Fishburne's in it, too.

cues.zh: “我还有多少戏份？”大概十二三分钟，第三幕。
cues.en: "How long have I got?" About twelve or thirteen minutes in, Act III.

cues.zh: 不过，往好处想，这比奥斯卡提名演员安迪·加西亚的遭遇好多了。
cues.en: But, you know, count your blessings, it's way better than what oscar-nominated actor Andy Garcia got.

cues.zh: *观众失望* 所以你可以把这个情节分成五个基本转折点：
cues.en: *audience disappointment* So you can break this plot up into five basic turning points:

cues.zh: 1. Chris醒来。2. Chris叫醒Jennifer。
cues.en: 1. Chris wakes up. 2. Chris wakes Jennifer up.

cues.zh: 3. 她发现了真相。4. Chris牺牲自己。
cues.en: 3. She finds out. 4. Chris sacrifices himself.

cues.zh: 5. 她原谅了他。电影中最强烈的紧张感发生在第2和第3部分之间。
cues.en: 5. She forgives him. The most acute tension in the film happens between parts 2 and 3.

cues.zh: 当Jennifer开始爱上Chris，但还不知道真相的时候。
cues.en: When Jennifer starts to fall in love with Chris, but doesn't yet know the truth.

cues.zh: 我们知道真相即将揭晓；那里有一点戏剧性讽刺。
cues.en: We know the truth is coming; there's a little dramatic irony there.

cues.zh: 于是我们带着越来越强的焦虑等待真相到来。而当真相到来时，不出所料，Jennifer不出所料地崩溃了，我们感到一点悲伤。不出所料。
cues.en: And so we wait with increasing anxiety until it does. And when it does, predictably, Jennifer freaks out, predictably, and we feel a little sadness. Predictably.

cues.zh: 此时，正好是电影进行到一小时的时候，剧本某种程度上已经把自己写进了死胡同。
cues.en: At this point, exactly an hour into the movie, the script has sort of written itself into a corner.

cues.zh: 因为Pratt才是真正的主角，因为电影开头我们和他独处了30分钟，通过他的眼睛看到一切，
cues.en: Because Pratt is the real main character, because we spend 30 minutes alone with him at the start of the film and see everything through his eyes,

cues.zh: 关于核心关系，其实只有两条路可走。
cues.en: There's really only two paths to take regarding the central relationship.

cues.zh: 要么他死，要么她原谅他。两条路都能让他所犯的罪得到赦免。
cues.en: Either he dies, or she forgives him. In both ways he finds absolution for the sin he committed.

cues.zh: 因为你没法把他变坏，这样一个角色是变不了的。
cues.en: Because you're not going to be able to turn him bad, not a character like this.

cues.zh: 除非你有五季的篇幅来铺垫。
cues.en: Not unless you have five seasons to do it.

cues.zh: 没错，我知道这里有些地方在致敬《闪灵》，但《闪灵》几乎没花任何时间去让我们喜欢上
cues.en: And yes, I know there are some allusions to "The Shining" here, but "The Shining" spent pretty much no time at all endearing us

cues.zh: 杰克·托兰斯这个角色。《乘客》则用整个第一幕让我们喜欢上可爱又倔强的克里斯·帕拉特。
cues.en: to the character of Jack Torrance. Passengers spends the whole first act endearing us to the lovable, scrappy Chris Pratt.

cues.zh: 很明显，主创或制片厂一心想把它做成爱情故事，所以他们选择了那种煽情的结局。
cues.en: It's clear the creators, or the studio, were intent on this being a love story, so they chose to go with the schmaltzy ending.

cues.zh: 但两种结局本来都可以选。最后45分钟反正都一样；一部几乎没有什么真正紧张感或悬念的电影。
cues.en: But they could have chosen either. The last 45 minutes would have been the same; a movie pretty much devoid of real tension or suspense.

cues.zh: 这需要在第三幕完全引入一个新的情节装置，即飞船彻底故障，才能给结局注入一些肾上腺素。
cues.en: Which requires a completely new plot device in the third act, the total malfunction of the ship, to juice the ending with some adrenaline.

cues.zh: 你们知道吗，几周前我在看Chris Stuckmann和Doug Walker对《太空旅客》的联合影评，Walker说了些有意思的话。
cues.en: You know a couple weeks ago, I was watching Chris Stuckmann and Doug Walker's joint review of "Passengers," and Walker said something interesting.

cues.zh: “如果他们换一种顺序讲述这个故事，会有趣十倍。”
cues.en: "If they told this in a different order, it would have been ten times more interesting."

cues.zh: 我开始想的是，如果你重新排列这部电影呢。让Jennifer Lawrence成为视角角色，而不是Chris Pratt？
cues.en: The thing I began to wonder is what if you rearranged the movie. So that Jennifer Lawrence was the point-of-view character, not Chris Pratt?

cues.zh: 如果电影从她的经历开始呢？我一直在想这件事，
cues.en: What if the film began with her experience? Well I couldn't stop thinking about it,

cues.zh: 所以我重新剪辑了现有的素材——看看故事会变成什么样
cues.en: So I re-edited the existing footage-see what would happen to the story

cues.zh: “早上好，Aurora。你感觉怎么样？你刚刚在休眠中度过了一百二十年——” *故障*
cues.en: "Good morning, Aurora. How are you feeling? You just spent 120 years in suspended animation-" *malfunction*

cues.zh: “有人吗？”
cues.en: "Hello?"

cues.zh: “有人吗？”
cues.en: "Anybody?"

cues.zh: “你好。”“嗨，你是乘客还是机组人员？”
cues.en: "Hello." "Hi, are you a passenger or crew?"

cues.zh: “乘客。吉姆·普雷斯顿。”“你知道发生什么了吗？我那排的其他人一个都没醒。”
cues.en: "Passenger. Jim Preston." "Do you know what's going on? Nobody else from my row woke up."

cues.zh: “我也是。”当我做出这个改动，并从那里观察时，一些有趣的事情开始发生了
cues.en: "Same for me." When I made this change and just watched from there, some interesting things started to happen

cues.zh: 首先，第一幕的基调完全变了。在原版第一幕中，你跟着克里斯·帕拉特在飞船里四处闲逛。
cues.en: First of all, the first act changes its tone entirely. With the original first act, you're wandering around the ship with Chris Pratt.

cues.zh: 你会了解到一些很酷的东西。你看到他逐渐接受现状，开心、沮丧，最终达到
cues.en: You learn cool things. You see him come to terms of the situation, have fun, get depressed, and finally reach the

cues.zh: 那个本应推动整部电影发展的道德困境。在这里，你看到的就是你得到的。
cues.en: ethical dilemma that's meant to animate the movie. What you see is what you get here.

cues.zh: 这使得观影体验有些被动。
cues.en: Which makes for somewhat passive viewing experience.

cues.zh: 这是一段有趣的序列，但这主要归功于酷炫的制作设计和帕拉特一贯迷人的表演。
cues.en: It's an amusing sequence, but that's mostly down to cool production design and Pratt's always charming performance.

cues.zh: “看来我要在这艘船上老死了。”
cues.en: "Guess I am going to die of old age on this ship."

cues.zh: 但在新的第一幕里，故事从一开始就充满了神秘感。
cues.en: But in the new first act, the story is infused from the start with mystery.

cues.zh: 当我做出剪辑改动时，我真心惊讶于普拉特饰演的角色有多诡异——一旦抽掉他的视角。
cues.en: When I made the editing changes, I was genuinely surprised by just how creepy Pratt's character is when you take away his point of view.

cues.zh: 我们不知道该不该信他，该不该相信他的话。这让观众的体验在每一刻都是主动的。
cues.en: We don't know whether to trust him or not, believe him or not. And that makes the audience's experience an active one in every moment.

cues.zh: “你知道怎么回事吗？我那排的人都没醒。”
cues.en: "Do you know what's going on? Nobody else from my row woke up."

cues.zh: “我也是。”当他带着詹妮弗在船上转悠时，各个地点变成了犯罪现场，观众试图弄清发生了什么。
cues.en: "Same for me." As he leads Jennifer around the ship, locations become crime scenes where the viewer tries to figure out what's happening.

cues.zh: 顺便说一句，这正是安德烈·塔可夫斯基的《飞向太空》如此伟大的原因。
cues.en: This, of course by the way, is what makes Andrei Tarkovsky's "Solaris" so great.

cues.zh: 等主角抵达时，《飞向太空》上已经发生了太多事，他和观众必须自己把碎片拼凑起来。
cues.en: So much has happened on Solaris by the time the lead character arrives that he and the audience have to piece the fragments together themselves.

cues.zh: 我是说，看看他有多瘆人。其实我觉得从这个角度看，Pratt的表演更有层次了。
cues.en: I mean, just look at how creepy he is. I actually think that Pratt's performance takes on more dimensions from this angle.

cues.zh: 你不会总被迫把他看作令人同情的一方，所以他的阴暗面就更凸显出来了。
cues.en: You're not always forced to see him as sympathetic, so his darker side comes out in greater relief.

cues.zh: 更重要的是，这部电影核心的那个黑暗选择，当第一次从Lawrence的视角来看时，冲击力更强。
cues.en: More important than that, the dark choice that sits at the heart of this film hits with greater impact when seen for the first time from Lawrence's perspective

cues.zh: 因为我们能像她一样感受到那份残酷。
cues.en: because we feel the cruelty as she feels it.

cues.zh: “你把我唤醒了吗？”
cues.en: "Did you wake me up?"

cues.zh: “我尽量没有。”
cues.en: "I tried not to."

cues.zh: *倒吸一口气*
cues.en: *gasp*

cues.zh: 现在我们到了原版故事走进死胡同的地方。
cues.en: Now we're at the point where the original story hits that dead end.

cues.zh: 但有了这个新剪辑，你有了更多可以发挥的选择。
cues.en: But with this new edit, you have some more options to play with.

cues.zh: 也就是说，用这个配置，你其实可以把Pratt变成反派，原版电影暗示了这一点，
cues.en: Namely, with this configuration, you could actually turn Pratt into the villain, the original film suggests,

cues.zh: 但没能贯彻下去，把《Passengers》拍成那么多影评人想看的惊悚恐怖片。
cues.en: But can't follow through on and make "Passengers" into the thriller horror film that so many critics wanted to see.

cues.zh: 你甚至可以把Chris独自在飞船上的那整段开头剪掉，但把它放在真相揭示之后，这样就不需要再证明他是个好人了。
cues.en: You can even cut back in that whole first section of Chris's time alone on the ship, but put it after the revelation without the need to justify his good guy-ness.

cues.zh: 你可以展现他孤独中更深层、更绝望的一面。
cues.en: You could show a deeper, more desperate side to his loneliness.

cues.zh: 我觉得这实际上会让他最终更令人同情，也会让他做出的选择更加痛苦。
cues.en: Something that I think actually would make him more sympathetic in the end and the choice he makes more agonizing.

cues.zh: *倒吸一口气*
cues.en: *gasp*

cues.zh: 当然，这种简单的剪切粘贴并不能解决剧本中的所有问题。比如结尾，仍然是个问题。
cues.en: Of course, this simple cut and paste doesn't solve every problem in the script. The ending, for example, is still an issue.

cues.zh: 我觉得你会想删掉那个故障麦高芬，但用真正的恐怖风格来收尾可能同样老套。
cues.en: I think you'd want to remove the malfunction McGuffin, but it might be just as trite to close the story in true horror fashion.

cues.zh: 按照Peter最后一部电影所暗示的那样，给它一个阴阳魔界式的结局可能会很酷，让Pratt死去，而Lawrence变得
cues.en: It could be cool to give it a twilight zone ending as Peter's last film suggested and have Pratt die and Lawrence gets

cues.zh: 如此孤独，以至于她开始考虑同样可怕的选择。
cues.en: so lonely that she begins to contemplate the same horrible choice.

cues.zh: 像这样头脑风暴显然很有趣，也比真正写一部电影并制作出来容易得多。
cues.en: Brainstorming like this is obviously really fun and much easier than actually writing a movie and making one.

cues.zh: 尽管有种种缺点，《太空旅客》是一部剧本完全原创的大预算电影，这一点值得庆祝，因为这种电影越来越少了。
cues.en: For all its faults, "Passengers is a big-budget movie with a completely original script, and that should be celebrated because it's a dying breed.

cues.zh: 但这样的电影对想成为编剧的人来说是个好机会，可以借此思考故事。
cues.en: But a film like this is a good opportunity for would-be screenwriters to think about story.

cues.zh: 因为从不成功的电影里，你能学到的东西和从成功电影里学到的一样多。
cues.en: Because you can learn just as much from films that don't work as you can from those that do.
